# TOOLS.md

## Local PC Work

- Use PowerShell for Windows inspection and commands.
- Prefer read-only checks before proposing changes.
- Good first-pass checks:
  - disk usage by drive and large folders
  - installed apps and startup items
  - running processes and high resource usage
  - Windows Security/Defender state
  - scheduled tasks and services
  - network/listening ports
  - recent system/application errors

## Safety

- Do not print secrets, tokens, cookies, credential files, or private document contents unless Jason specifically asks and the task requires it.
- Get approval before delete/uninstall/disable/registry/firewall/security-setting changes.
